Fanhouse Residency with Chitrangada Satarupa

Four days in the jungle at Jungli, The Nomad Village, Dandeli. Jan 7-10, 2027. Acting workshops, a small group, and something you’ll make together by the end.

Apply now16 spots, invite-only

Welcome to The Fanhouse Residency

This form isn’t about impressing us. It’s simply how we get to know who you are, what excites you, and how you’d like to be part of this experience.

The residency runs from Jan 7-10, 2027, at Jungli, The Nomad Village, Dandeli (3N/4D). Over these few days, you’ll be part of a small, thoughtfully curated group, sharing conversations and experiences, exploring 150 acres of lush greens, attending workshops led by Chitrangada, and collaborating to create something together, whether that’s a short film, a sketch, or a drama series.

The experience begins with a 3-hour journey from Goa on the morning of Jan 7, and you’ll depart in the afternoon of Jan 10, reaching Goa by the evening.

Wondering what Jungli is? Have a look for yourself.

Your host, Chitrangada Satarupa

Chitrangada is an actor, director and multidisciplinary artist from Kolkata, now based in Mumbai. You might know her from Tikli and Laxmi Bomb, The Goddess and the Hero, Mariam, or Guilty Minds on Amazon Prime. Her latest film is below.

She started out in experimental theatre in Kolkata and Mumbai before moving to screen. She has also directed music videos and a short film, and she runs acting workshops for people just starting out, with a focus on the craft of performance.

Main Actor Nahin Hoon

In 2026, Chitrangada starred opposite Nawazuddin Siddiqui in Main Actor Nahin Hoon, written and directed by Aditya Kripalani. At the residency, you’ll be learning from someone who is working in front of the camera right now.

Where you’ll stay

Jungli, The Nomad Village

You’ll be staying at Jungli in Dandeli, on 150 acres of green. Rooms are twin sharing, all meals are included, and there are common spaces for workshops, games and long evenings with the group.

A space that hosts communities

Jungli plays host to groups of creators and curious people who come to learn, make things and spend time together. You’ll be one of 16 here, so expect to actually get to know everyone.

What to expect

  • 3 nights in a comfortable stay (twin sharing)
  • All meals included
  • A curated itinerary including a jungle trail, sunset hike, river rafting, paddle tournament, and much more
  • Guided sessions led by Chitrangada Satarupa
  • Time to explore, hang out, and get to know the group
  • Collaborate and create something together by the end of the residency
